title: Test that refusals survive resume and parallel calls, and flag stale claims
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (f), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/f-g-h-radar.md
Outcome: Three untested authorization paths gain mechanical checks: a refused PreToolUse payload stays refused after SessionStart resume|compact; one refused call among parallel PreToolUse payloads does not drop or release the others; krn doctor flags claims older than N hours with no commit.
Proof: node --test on dispatch tests replaying a refused payload after resume, a two-payload parallel case with per-call decisions, and a krn doctor stale-claim fixture, all passing.
